q: A language is context-free if and only if some pushdown automaton accepts it.
explain: True. CFG → PDA and PDA → CFG are both constructive, so CFGs and (nondeterministic) PDAs describe the same class of languages.

q: In the standard CFG → PDA construction, how many states does the PDA need (accepting by empty stack)?
explain: All the work happens on the stack. One state q, with expand and match moves, is enough.

q: In the CFG → PDA construction, what happens when a variable A is on top of the stack?
options: An ε-move replaces A with the right side α of some production A → α
A is matched against the next input symbol
explain: Variables are expanded by guessing a production, without reading input. Only terminals are matched against the input.

q: In the CFG → PDA construction, what happens when a terminal a is on top and the next input symbol is a?
options: Pop a and read the input symbol
explain: δ(q, a, a) = (q, ε). The terminal predicted by the derivation has been seen in the input, so it is removed.

q: The PDA built from S → aSb | ε starts with S on the stack and reads aabb. What is on the stack (top first) just after the first expansion S → aSb?
explain: α is pushed with its leftmost symbol on top, so the next step matches a against the input, just as in a leftmost derivation.

q: If the grammar is in GNF, the production A → aα becomes which PDA move?
options: δ(q, a, A) ∋ (q, α): read a, replace A with α
explain: GNF puts a terminal first, so expanding and then matching it can be combined into one move that reads a.

q: In the PDA → CFG triple construction, the variable [pXq] generates…
options: the strings that take the PDA from state p with X on top to state q, with X popped
the strings that push X in state p
all strings ending in state q
the stack contents between p and q
explain: [pXq] ⇒* w exactly when the PDA can read w, starting in p with X on top, and end in q with X (and whatever replaced it) gone.

q: With |Q| states and |Γ| stack symbols, how many variables of the form [pXq] can the triple construction create?
explain: There is one variable for each choice of start state p, stack symbol X and end state q. Many turn out useless and are removed afterwards.

q: Why does the CFG → PDA construction use nondeterminism?
options: When several productions exist for A, the PDA guesses which one the derivation uses
To count beyond the stack size
explain: The PDA does not know in advance which production leads to the input. It tries all of them on different branches, and one successful branch is enough.

q: In the PDA → CFG construction, which productions does the start symbol S get?
explain: The PDA starts in q₀ with Z₀, and accepts when Z₀ has been popped, in whatever state it ends.
